nameOrigin: envious (Zweilous’ heads fight with each other)

pokedexEntries.bk: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

pokedexEntries.wh: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

pokedexEntries.sw: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

pokedexEntries.sh: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
